description: This file implements the ModemSimulator class, which manages various modem services such as network, SIM, SMS, and others, providing methods for initialization, command dispatching, and state management within a modem simulation environment.

classes.name: ModemSimulator
classes.description: A class that simulates a modem, managing multiple services and handling commands.

methods.name: ModemSimulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the modem with a given ID.

methods.name: ~ModemSimulator
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread looper and clears services.

methods.name: LoadNvramConfig
methods.description: Loads the NVRAM configuration for the modem.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the modem with a channel monitor and loads configuration.

methods.name: RegisterModemService
methods.description: Registers and sets up all modem services.

methods.name: DispatchCommand
methods.description: Dispatches a command from a client to the appropriate service.

methods.name: OnFirstClientConnected
methods.description: Handles actions when the first client connects.

methods.name: SaveModemState
methods.description: Saves the current state of the modem.

methods.name: IsRadioOn
methods.description: Checks if the radio is on.

methods.name: IsWaitingSmsPdu
methods.description: Checks if the modem is waiting for an SMS PDU.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the modem.

methods.name: SetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets the phone number in the SIM service.
